newsitem.title: USA: Dart extends settlement pact with Haft.
newsitem.headline: Dart extends settlement pact with Haft.

text.p: Dart Group Corp said Friday that a conditional settlement agreement in principle with its founder Herbert Haft has been extended by two weeks.
The conditional agreement was to end if a definitive settlement with Haft, who is also the company's chairman and chief executive, was not reached by May 9.
Dart said Friday that it and Haft had not reached a definitive pact and that the agreement in principle will now end if a definitive agreement is not reached by May 23.

Haft had agreed to a $42 million cash buyout in April to give up control of the multimillion dollar retail empire he founded. The company filed for bankruptcy in 1995 after a four-year-long fued among family members for control of the companies.
